ev.q: Including the index case, five cases were identified, with illness onsets from January 25 through March 25.
Four patients were morbidly obese (weights were 350, 374, and approximately 350 lbs; weight was not recorded for one).
Four lived in the city of Spokane (1999 population: 189,000), and one lived in a nearby town.
All cases were community acquired and fatal within 5 days of onset.
This report describes a cluster of fatal illnesses caused by GAS in five residents of Spokane County

methods_quotes.q: GAS isolates from all patients were compared using PFGE with three separate enzymes
Medical records of each patient were reviewed
